title: Decide where collect and cancel live for the cloudflare-sandbox executor before keh claims all four operations
body: internal/reconcile's Executor interface needs Start, Inspect, CollectDetail and Cancel, but the new dispatch door (tick 8ty) exposes only start and state. Collect's landing-branch-to-write_ref push and the salvage-door teardown currently live Worker-side (sandbox-executor.ts collectAttempt/cancelAttempt), and the door's header deliberately documents them as absent. Either keh adds collect/cancel routes beside the two that exist (in src/sandbox-dispatch.ts, the one contract place), or the tick records that the Go reconciler reads git directly and only cancel needs a route — the decision should be made before keh's acceptance is judged against 'the same interface as subprocess'.
